title: Opportunity of being heard
description: Exception to passing an order without hearing

content.general_rule: The Central Authority may pass an order based on investigation where it is satisfied that there is sufficient evidence to show violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practice
content.exception: The Central Authority shall give the person an opportunity of being heard before passing an order
conditions: before passing an order under this section
